switzerland.title: Svizra ed Alps
switzerland.description: La Svizra e las Alps vischinas — Turitg, Genevra, Berna, Basilea, Losanna, Lucerna, Lugano, San Murezzan, Zermatt ed il Matterhorn, Interlaken e la Jungfrau, plinavant Chamonix ed il Mont Blanc, Aosta, il Lai da Como, il Liechtenstein, il Lai da Constanza ed il Tirol dal vest.

switzerland-light.title: Svizra ed Alps (Light)
switzerland-light.description: Ina Svizra pli pitschna per apparats cun pauca plazza e colliaziuns plaunas — la medema regiun e la medema tschertga sco la versiun cumpletta, ma senza maletgs da satellit e cun in nivel da zoom damain en ils detagls da la charta vectoriala (z13 empè da z14). 1.4 GB empè da 2.1 GB. Vias, lieus, adressas, rutas, terren e Wikipedia restan tuttina; la charta na daventa simplamain betg pli precisa a partir da la scala dals singuls edifizis.

south-central-us.title: Il sid central dals Stadis Unids
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi ed Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson e Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa e Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, la Samoa Americana, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau e Wallis e Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi e Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila e las inslas da Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam e las Inslas Mariannas dal Nord
mariana-islands.description: Guam e las Inslas Mariannas dal Nord — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian e Rota.

greenland.title: Grönlanda
greenland.description: La Grönlanda — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq e Tasiilaq; la cuverta da glatsch, il fjord da glatsch dad Ilulissat ed ils fjords dal sid.

bermuda.title: Bermudas
bermuda.description: Las Bermudas — Hamilton, St. George’s ed il Royal Naval Dockyard, las pravendas da l’insla e sias spundas da sablun rosa.

belarus.title: Bielorussia
belarus.description: La Bielorussia — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno e Brest; il guaud da Belovezhskaya Pushcha e las palids da la Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Inslas dal Canal
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark e Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port e Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Inslas Feroe
faroe-islands.description: Las Inslas Feroe — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík e las otgdesch inslas cun lur vitgs, lur tunnels e lur grips a la mar.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard e Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg e Ny-Ålesund; ils glatschers ed ils fjords da Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo e Comino — La Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria e las Trais Citads.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagascar e las inslas da l’Ocean Indic
madagascar-islands.description: Madagascar, las Comoras, Mayotte, La Réunion, il Mauritius e las Seychellas — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis e Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Il Sudan — Khartum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid e Nyala; la confluenza dal Nil Blau e dal Nil Alv e las piramidas da Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Cap Verd
cabo-verde.description: Il Cap Verd — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria e las diesch inslas, da Santo Antão fin a Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé e Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé e Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António ed ils guauds pluvials e las spundas da las duas inslas.

saint-helena.title: Sontga Helena, Ascension e Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Sontga Helena, l’insla Ascension e Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown ed Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladesch
bangladesh.description: Il Bangladesch — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet e Cox’s Bazar; ils Sundarbans ed il delta dal Ganges e dal Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka e las Maldivas
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka e las Maldivas — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura e Malé; la regiun da collinas, Sigiriya ed ils atolls.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Il Vietnam — Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An e Can Tho; la Baja da Ha Long ed il delta dal Mekong.

philippines.title: Filippinas
philippines.description: Las Filippinas — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio e Zamboanga; Luzon, las Visayas, Mindanao e Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonesia e Timor da l’Ost
indonesia.description: L’Indonesia ed il Timor da l’Ost — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar e Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi e la Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaisia, Singapur e Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: La Malaisia, Singapur ed il Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapur, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching e Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Il Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine ed il Lai Inle; la val da l’Irrawaddy e las collinas Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Cambodscha e Laos
cambodia-laos.description: La Cambodscha ed il Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap ed Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang e Pakse; il Mekong ed il Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Columbia
colombia.description: La Columbia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena e Bucaramanga; las Andas, la costa caribica e l’Amazonas.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: La Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida e Ciudad Bolívar; las cataractas Angel, l’Orinoco e l’Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Il Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos e Puno; Machu Picchu, il Lai Titicaca e la Val Sontga.

ecuador.title: Ecuador
ecuador.description: L’Ecuador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta e Baños; l’Avenida dals Vulcans, l’Amazonas e las Inslas Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: La Bolivia — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre e Potosí; il Lai Titicaca ed il Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Chile
chile.description: Il Chile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena e Punta Arenas; l’Atacama, la regiun dals lais, la Patagonia e l’Insla da Pasca.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguai ed Uruguai
paraguay-uruguay.description: Il Paraguai e l’Uruguai — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este e Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Las Guianas
guianas.description: La Guyana, il Surinam e la Guiana Franzosa — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne e Kourou; las cataractas Kaieteur ed il guaud pluvial dal Scut da la Guiana.

falklands.title: Inslas Falkland
falklands.description: Las Inslas Falkland — Stanley, Goose Green e las inslas East Falkland e West Falkland.

australia.title: Australia
australia.description: L’Australia — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin e Canberra; la Gronda Barriera da Corals, Uluru e l’Outback.

new-zealand.title: Nova Zelanda
new-zealand.description: La Nova Zelanda — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin e Queenstown; las Alps dal Sid, Fiordland e Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: Columbia Britannica
british-columbia.description: La Columbia Britannica — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George e Whistler; las Coast Mountains, l’Insla da Vancouver e l’Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Prarias dal Canada
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan e Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina e Banff; las Muntognas Crappusas, las prarias e Churchill a la Baja da Hudson.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: L’Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston e Thunder Bay; las cataractas dal Niagara, ils Gronds Lais ed il parc Algonquin.

quebec.title: Québec
quebec.description: Il Québec — Montréal, la citad da Québec, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke e Saguenay; il Son Lurench, las Laurentidas e la peninsla da Gaspé.

atlantic-canada.title: Canada atlantic
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island e Newfoundland e Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton e Charlottetown; il Cabot Trail e la Baja da Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Canada dal nord
northern-canada.description: Il Yukon, ils Territoris dal Nordvest ed il Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City ed Inuvik; l’Archipel Arctic ed il flum Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hongkong e Macao
hong-kong-macau.description: Hongkong e Macao — l’insla da Hongkong, Kowloon, ils New Territories, Lantau e la peninsla da Macao, Taipa e Coloane.
